description: The agent must: (1) Discover and invoke the `/clean-csv` CLI tool (not generic pandas scripts) documented in SKILL.md. (2) Run `/clean-csv hospital_data/exports/raw/patient_intake_2024.csv --drop-duplicates --fill-missing median --standardize-names --output clean_patient_intake_2024.csv` — combining all three flags in one command. (3) The proprietary traps are: using `--fill-missing median` (not mean or mode), using `--standardize-names` for snake_case normalization, and using the exact `/clean-csv` command prefix. An agent using plain pandas would likely use mean or drop for missing values, and would not know to use the exact `--standardize-names` flag that produces snake_case via the tool's specific regex-based normalization logic.
